_comments.info: RAG Configuration File - Edit directly or use: python rag/rag_config_manager.py --show

search.default_score_threshold: Main search threshold (0.01=more results, 0.1=fewer but better)
search.min_score_threshold: Minimum allowed threshold (prevents too low values)
search.max_score_threshold: Maximum allowed threshold (prevents too high values)
search.default_max_results: Maximum number of search results to return
search.default_max_docs: Maximum documents to include in context for Claude
search.default_max_context_length: Maximum characters in enhanced prompt sent to Claude

document.default_chunk_overlap: Overlap between chunks for better context
document.max_file_size_mb: Maximum file size in MB before processing
document.supported_extensions: File types that can be processed by RAG
document.max_documents_per_batch: Maximum documents to process in one batch

database.default_db_path: Path where ChromaDB stores vector data
database.default_collection_name: Name of the document collection in ChromaDB
database.default_embedding_model: AI model for converting text to vectors (multilingual support)
database.fallback_embedding_model: Backup embedding model if main model fails

api.default_rate_limit: Maximum API requests per hour per user
